paragraph: Hillary Clinton has surprised the world with her unconventional campaign launch. While some critics have dismissed her efforts as vapid and boring, there is no denying that her launch has been successful from a marketing perspective. Her YouTube announcement video successfully portrays her as confident, fresh, and forward-looking. Clinton's team is attempting to create an empathetic relationship
